page.layout: One centred title page: title lines at top, a fleuron ornament, a woodcut engraving in the middle, and the printer's imprint with date at the foot. No running head, page number or signature.
page.notes: Between the title lines and the engraving stands a small printer's fleuron (ornament), not text. Central woodcut: an oval wreath of fruit and foliage with ribboned banners at the sides and top and bottom. Inside it a seated nude female figure with a halo or arch above her head, a small pedestal to her left, and a dog or animal at her feet. No printed text in the cartouche. The imprint date is printed as "cIↄ Iↄ XCVIII" with reversed-C numerals; given here as MDXCVIII. A blue manuscript "13" in the top right corner is a handwritten shelf or library mark and is left out.
